test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Each side of an equilateral triangle is 6 cm long. What is its area (in cm²)?
solution:
**Given:**

Side = 6 cm

**Formula used:**

Area of equilateral triangle = (√3side²)/4

**Calculations:**

Area of the equilateral triangle

⇒ √3side²/4

⇒ √3 × 6²/4

⇒ 9√3 cm²

**Hence, The Required value is 9√3 cm².**
